banner.title: Your cookie choices
banner.body: We use essential cookies to run Vireek. With your permission we also use analytics (Google Analytics) and campaign measurement. Nothing optional loads until you choose.

center.title: Cookie settings
center.intro: Choose which optional cookies and similar storage Vireek may use. You can change this at any time; withdrawing takes effect immediately.
center.neverSaved: No choice saved yet. Optional cookies are off.
center.signalLocked: Off. Your browser sends a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal, and we honor it.

essential.title: Essential
essential.summary: Needed for sign-in, security and to remember your choices. Cannot be turned off.
essential.collected: Your sign-in session, your cookie choice, theme and language settings, and security tokens.
essential.purpose: To run and protect the site and dashboard.
essential.retention: Sign-in: until you sign out or it expires. Cookie choice: up to 12 months. Theme and language: until you clear them.
essential.recipients: Vireek and its hosting and authentication provider (Supabase).
essential.storage: Supabase sign-in session, vireek-consent-v3, vireek-theme, vireek-a11y-lang (browser storage).

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.summary: Shows us which pages are used so we can improve Vireek.
analytics.collected: Pages visited, referrer, browser and device type, approximate location, a random visitor ID, and which A/B test variant you saw.
analytics.purpose: To understand usage and improve the product. Not used for advertising.
analytics.retention: Google Analytics cookies last up to 2 years. Report retention is set in our Google Analytics account.

marketing.title: Marketing measurement
marketing.summary: Remembers which campaign link brought you here, so we can tell which campaigns work.
marketing.collected: Campaign details from the link you arrived on (such as utm_source) and a random visitor ID on campaign landing pages.
marketing.purpose: To measure which campaigns lead to sign-ups. No ad networks and no ad profiles.
marketing.retention: Campaign details: 30 days. Visitor ID: until you withdraw consent or clear your browser storage.
marketing.recipients: Vireek and its database host (Supabase). Not shared with advertisers.
